newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.594 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.594 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended February 15 was 5,594,594 gallons compared with 4,981,005 gallons last week.
Imports were 1,697,456 gallons compared with 520,301 gallons the previous week. There were no domestic receipts this week or the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,108,956 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,014,956 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 56,854,655 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 139,763,847 gallons.
